_about: Public-domain George Park Fisher (1827-1909), Titus Street Professor of Ecclesiastical History at Yale, for the Word Hoard: Essays on the Supernatural Origin of Christianity (1866), The Reformation (1873), The Beginnings of Christianity (1877), The Grounds of Theistic and Christian Belief (1883), History of the Christian Church (1887) and History of Christian Doctrine (1896), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 35 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

gpfisher-supernatural-origin: Essays on the Supernatural Origin of Christianity, with special reference to the theories of Renan, Strauss, and the Tübingen School (New York: Charles Scribner & Co., 1866)
